key_insight: HVAF-sprayed bondcoats incorporating alumina showed a strong positive correlation between alumina content and thermal barrier coating lifetime, alongside more protective oxide-scale formation.
engineering_relevance: Oxide dispersion strengthened bondcoats offer a route to more durable thermal barrier coatings by promoting a dense alumina scale and limiting detrimental mixed oxides.
method: Deposited nine coatings using two commercial MCrAlY powders with varying alumina additions.
Introduced alumina by twin-feeding or mechanical blending during HVAF spraying; applied identical SPS topcoats.
Evaluated microstructure, isothermal oxidation, and thermal cycling fatigue.
evidence_signal: SEM confirmed alumina incorporation preferentially at splat boundaries, while thermal cycling showed strong positive correlations between alumina content and coating lifetime.
watch_item: Alumina incorporation efficiency remained limited, even though mechanical blending improved its distribution.
paper_title: Development of Oxide Dispersion Strengthened Bondcoats by High-Velocity Air Fuel Spraying
